page: Google Cloud Platform z4d-highmem-64-standardlssd is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the z4d server family. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs built on the x86_64 CPU architecture. The instance is equipped with 504.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of approximately 7.88 GB of RAM per virtual core. This allocation profile provides a high memory-to-vCPU ratio suitable for memory-intensive workloads.

The server operates with dedicated CPU allocation, ensuring consistent compute performance without resource contention from neighboring tenants. It does not include integrated graphics processing units, as the GPU count is zero. While the instance is classified under a storage-optimized designation in its basic profile, the primary local storage size is listed as none, indicating that external block storage must be provisioned for persistent data requirements. There are zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this configuration.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the z4d-highmem-64-standardlssd offers a dense memory footprint relative to its compute cores, making it a viable option for workloads that require substantial memory capacity without the overhead of additional CPU licensing. This resource balance is well-suited for large-scale databases, in-memory analytics, enterprise applications, and memory-bound data processing tasks.
